technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) novelty：provider 适配沿用既有机制取小幅；mechanism：共享路径、spill 和取消有具体组合取实质；transferability：[Q03](#research-q03) 可借鉴但绑定宿主与 runtime 取实质；simplification：统一入口减少接线但需配置取实质以下。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) workflow：统一虚拟文件与命令改变操作取实质；delivery：[Q04](#research-q04) 需另配 workspace 和宿主取小幅；reach：特定 DSH 用户取小幅；economics：无任务成本对照，未知。

recommendation.reason: 需要在 DSH 使用 Mirage 挂载的开发者，可先在独立 profile 用只读或内存数据试用。相比原生 provider，它将文件与 shell 接入同一虚拟工作区，但会改变路径和审批语义。若权限或路径不一致，应停止真实数据接入并回退原生 provider。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 人群、虚拟工作区任务与原生基线明确达一半；真实需求频率未知不足更高档。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 文件和 shell 共用路径超出界面包装；实际一致性和收益未测不足更高档。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) 子组件源码覆盖 provider、spill 和审批主要分支；未运行宿主不足本地测试档。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 需维护虚拟路径、runtime 和权限且取消有缺口；可回退高于零，恢复未测不足一半。

# Mirage DSH Providers > 为 DSH 的文件和 shell provider 接入 Mirage 工作区。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[strukto-ai/mirage](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage) - **版本号**：0.0.8-alpha.2（[固定提交 de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/tree/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-01（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定子组件源码支持共享 workspace 与审批映射；未运行宿主或根平台。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：希望 DSH 操作 Mirage 挂载工作区的平台开发者；基线为原生文件和 shell。[Q01](#research-q01) - **亮点**：把两个 DSH provider 接到同一虚拟路径空间；Mirage 平台功能不归子组件。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) - **思考**：单次 VFS 操作不能在内部取消，spill 可能失败；无 approver 保持待决而不是自动通过。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) - **建议**：未验证假设：非破坏性检查 fs、shell、spill 和审批的一致性可减少错配；须对照现有共享分发验证。[Q05](#research-q05) 采用建议：先在独立 profile 验证只读挂载、长输出和审批；不一致则回原生 provider。[Q04](#research-q04) ## 核心贡献 把两个 DSH provider 接到同一虚拟路径空间；Mirage 平台功能不归子组件。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) ## 关键质疑 单次 VFS 操作不能在内部取消，spill 可能失败；无 approver 保持待决而不是自动通过。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 未验证假设：非破坏性检查 fs、shell、spill 和审批的一致性可减少错配；须对照现有共享分发验证。[Q05](#research-q05) 固定宿主与平台，以只读样本核验路径、spill、取消和审批。 ## 场景与替代办法 希望 DSH 操作 Mirage 挂载工作区的平台开发者；基线为原生文件和 shell。[Q01](#research-q01) 使用 DSH 原生文件系统、shell 和宿主审批。[Q01](#research-q01) ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 兼容 DSH 和 Node | 必需 | provider 宿主 | 不加载 | | Mirage workspace | 必需 | 虚拟文件与 shell | 停止配置 | | 正确挂载及审批 | 真实数据需要 | 权限与操作 | 不接真实数据 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 独立 profile 配置假源 | 确认路径 | | 核查 | 用 fs 与 shell 操作同样本 | 一致后继续 | | 退出 | 移除 provider | 恢复原生行为 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | workspace 与 runtime 资源 | 挂载配置 | 宿主未测 | | 持续 | 后端调用费用未知 | 审查权限与路径 | 效率未测 | | 恢复 | spill 和远端资源 | 处理取消与不一致 | 单次 VFS 可能继续 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 同一路径 | fs 与 shell 接 workspace | 所有后端一致 | | 审批 | 未提供 approver 保持待决 | 实际宿主交互 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：Mirage DSH provider 如何连接文件、shell 和审批，其隔离与取消边界是什么？ ### Q01 · DSH 适配器相比原生文件和 shell 提供什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 希望 DSH 使用 Mirage 挂载工作区的开发者可通过该子包替换 ctx.fs 与 ctx.shell；相对原生文件系统和 shell，增量是让两者走同一虚拟路径空间。Mirage 工作区和后端能力来自独立平台，不能归为适配器新增算法；单一普通本地项目可能无需替换。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/package.json:1-5](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/package.json#L1-L5) 子包身份与 provider 描述。 ```text { "name": "@struktoai/mirage-dsh", "version": "0.0.8-alpha.2", "description": "DeepSeek Harness (dsh) providers backed by a mirage workspace: ctx.fs and ctx.shell over mounts", "homepage": "https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage#readme", ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/src/fs.ts:165-171](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/src/fs.ts#L165-L171) 文件系统与 shell 共用虚拟工作区。 ```text /** * Mirage-backed implementation of `ctx.fs`. Targets are canonical virtual * paths (namespace symlinks followed), every operation walks the workspace * dispatcher — session grants, admission policies, cache read-through and * post-write invalidation all fire exactly as they do for a shell command — * and `processPath` answers in the same virtual path space the mirage shell * executes in, so the two providers share one execution world. ``` #### 缺口 - 未运行 DSH、Mirage 或外部数据源 **影响**：无法证明路径一致、审批和运行时隔离 **进一步探讨**：隔离 profile 验证 fs、shell、spill 和审批 ### Q02 · 文件、shell 和大输出如何保持同一世界？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 文件 provider 将操作交给 workspace dispatcher 并解析虚拟路径；shell 默认每个命令使用临时 fork，配置具名 session 才保持 cwd 和环境。大输出可写到同一 workspace 的 spill 文件，但配置目录不可写时可能无法恢复完整输出；取消信号只在适配边界检查，单次远端 VFS 操作内部不能中断。该源码体现适配，不证明每个后端语义一致。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/src/fs.ts:165-177](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/src/fs.ts#L165-L177) 共享路径及单次操作取消边界。
查看原文（13行） ```text /** * Mirage-backed implementation of `ctx.fs`. Targets are canonical virtual * paths (namespace symlinks followed), every operation walks the workspace * dispatcher — session grants, admission policies, cache read-through and * post-write invalidation all fire exactly as they do for a shell command — * and `processPath` answers in the same virtual path space the mirage shell * executes in, so the two providers share one execution world. * * One limit worth stating: mirage's `ws.vfs` takes no `AbortSignal`, so * cancellation is honored at this adapter's own boundaries (before a * dispatch, between listing entries) and not inside a single op. A long * read from a remote backend therefore runs to completion after the * signal fires, and the caller learns of the abort when it returns. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/src/shell.ts:484-493](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/src/shell.ts#L484-L493) 默认 fork 与具名 session。
查看原文（10行） ```text * CLIs, the policy layer) against the shared `ctx.mirage` workspace, so a * path from `ctx.fs` means the same file here. There is no OS process * behind a command: `signal` in results is a compatibility value for kills, * and abort/timeout act cooperatively at the executor's own boundaries. * * Every command runs in an ephemeral fork of the workspace's default * session, so no shell state survives from one call to the next, matching * the one-shot contract of dsh's bash tool. Configuring a `sessionId` * binds all commands to one named session instead, whose cwd, exports, * and functions persist across calls. ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/src/shell.ts:550-574](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/src/shell.ts#L550-L574) spill 使用 workspace 与失败日志。
查看原文（25行） ```text // A spill sink for one background command, or null when no spill // directory is configured. The target reaches the live workspace so // the full stream lands on a mount the agent can read back. private newSpill(): SpillSink | null { const dir = this.spillDir if (dir === undefined) return null const target: SpillTarget = { ensureDir: async (d) => { const ws = await this.workspace() await ensureDirPath({ exists: (p) => ws.vfs.exists(p), mkdir: (p) => ws.vfs.mkdir(p) }, d) }, write: async (p, bytes) => { const ws = await this.workspace() await ws.vfs.write(p, bytes) }, append: async (p, bytes) => { const ws = await this.workspace() await ws.vfs.append(p, bytes) }, } spillCounter += 1 const log = this.ctx.logger('mirage-dsh') return new SpillSink(target, dir, `mirage-shell-${spillCounter.toString()}`, (err: unknown) => { log.debug('spill to %s failed, output will not be recoverable: %o', dir, err) ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/src/spill.ts:63-74](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/src/spill.ts#L63-L74) 大输出落盘意图和写入失败。
查看原文（12行） ```text /** * Keeps the full, uncapped stdout and stderr of one command in workspace * files so a reader can recover output the delta budget dropped. * * Memory stays bounded: each channel buffers in memory only until the * delivered delta first overruns its budget, at which point `begin()` * flushes both buffers to their files and every later chunk appends * straight to the file. A write failure (no writable mount at the * configured path) disables the sink and leaves the paths undefined, the * honest "no safe path available" answer, so the process still streams, * just without a spill to point at. */ ```
#### 缺口 - 未运行 DSH、Mirage 或外部数据源 **影响**：无法证明路径一致、审批和运行时隔离 **进一步探讨**：隔离 profile 验证 fs、shell、spill 和审批 ### Q03 · 权限和审批是否与原生行为完全相同？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑、功能与机制 #### 完整回答 只有 vfsOnly 时文件 provider 声明 workspace-write，否则不宣称该约束；目录无效时可能回退配置的虚拟 cwd。审批桥区分拒绝、取消、不可用与没有 approver：前几种拒绝，没有 approver 返回 null 保持待决，而非自动批准。虚拟挂载和 runtime 本身仍需正确配置；统一 provider 不证明外部源隔离或取消即时生效。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/src/fs.ts:232-243](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/src/fs.ts#L232-L243) vfsOnly 约束声明。
查看原文（12行） ```text /** * The same confinement claim `MirageShellExecutor` makes, off the same * fact and for the same reason: with every runtime reaching only the * vfs, a mutation cannot land anywhere but a mount, under its mode. * * The two seams sit over one world, so answering differently here * would let dsh fence a bash write and wave an identical `ctx.fs` * write straight through. */ override get sandboxMode(): FileSystem['sandboxMode'] { return this.ctx.mirage.vfsOnly ? 'workspace-write' : undefined ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/src/fs.ts:270-285](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/src/fs.ts#L270-L285) 不在虚拟世界的 cwd 回退。
查看原文（16行） ```text * dsh hands `ctx.fs` either the calling session's cwd or the sandbox * policy's workspace root, and both are directories on the harness's * own machine that name nothing here. Resolving `notes.txt` against * one yields `/Users/.../notes.txt`, which every read then reports as * absent. So a base that is not a directory in this world falls back * to the configured one, the same rule the shell executor applies to * a workdir. * * An absolute path ignores its base, so it never pays for the probe. * * @param path the path being resolved. * @param cwd the caller's base, if any. * @returns the base to resolve against. */ private async resolveBase(path: string, cwd: string | undefined): Promise { if (cwd === undefined || posix.isAbsolute(path)) return this.cwd ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/src/approval.ts:124-151](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/src/approval.ts#L124-L151) 审批拒绝与缺 approver 的待决区别。
查看原文（28行） ```text * nod into a standing grant is the one thing the human did not * consent to; a host that wants SESSION answers writes them to the * ledger itself (`ws.decisions.answer`), the surface built for it. * * `rejected` is an explicit refusal. * * `cancelled` is a refusal too: the human was shown the prompt and * dismissed it, which is an answer rather than the absence of one. * Leaving it pending would re-prompt them, since a retry reuses the * waiting record and would call `request` again. * * `unavailable` is a permission check that could not run, so it * fails closed. Pending here would be fail-open-into-retry. * * The three refusals match what dsh does with the same vocabulary for * its own escalations, where `approveEscalation` throws on a rejection, * a cancellation and an unanswerable ask alike. * * The run's own signal rides along, so a prompt raised for a line whose * run is then killed or times out is dismissed with it rather than left * on somebody's screen for a command that no longer exists. The ledger * stops waiting either way — it bounds the wait by the same signal — but * only the channel can take its prompt down. * * With no approver on the context the handler answers null, which is * mirage's "nobody has answered yet": the ask stays pending in the * ledger. That is deliberate, and it is why the service installs this * unconditionally rather than only under a composed approver — the two * are the same answer to mirage (`onAsk` unset and a null return both * render pending), and installing always is what lets an approver * composed after this plugin still be found. ```
#### 缺口 - 未运行 DSH、Mirage 或外部数据源 **影响**：无法证明路径一致、审批和运行时隔离 **进一步探讨**：隔离 profile 验证 fs、shell、spill 和审批 ### Q04 · 怎样安全试用和退出？ **研究主题**：依赖、兼容与流程、效果与总成本、采用判断 #### 完整回答 需要兼容 DSH、Node 和已配置的 Mirage workspace、挂载与 runtime；切换 provider 会改变路径、审批和取消语义。先在独立 profile 用内存/只读挂载验证同一文件的 fs 与 shell 读写、长输出与审批，再逐项接入真实后端；路径不一致或权限不清时停止并回原生 provider。部署和数据源费用、兼容性与效果未测。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/package.json:19-21](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/package.json#L19-L21) Node 版本范围。 ```text "type": "module", "engines": { "node": "^22.20 || ^24.12 || >=25" ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[typescript/packages/dsh/src/fs.ts:165-177](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/de311792e60fe6f7edb6e18cb5411a843b4849db/typescript/packages/dsh/src/fs.ts#L165-L177) 共享工作区和取消限制。
查看原文（13行） ```text /** * Mirage-backed implementation of `ctx.fs`.
